# Technical Plan: Nemotron-H Hybrid Inference on 12GB CUDA GPU

## 1. Architecture Analysis & Tensor Mapping

The Nemotron-H model (context: `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp`) employs a hybrid architecture with **Mamba2 SSM layers** (recurrent, `is_recr(i)=true`), **standard attention layers**, and **Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)** layers. The routing and expert tensors are the primary memory consumers.

### Critical Tensor Inventory (per layer `i`):

| Tensor Name | Shape | Category | Offload Strategy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `layer.ssm_in` | `{n_embd, d_in_proj}` | **Mamba2 Input Proj** | **GPU Resident** (Small: ~2-5MB per layer) |
| `layer.ssm_conv1d` | `{d_conv, d_inner + 2*n_group*d_state}` | **Mamba2 Conv1d** | **GPU Resident** |
| `layer.ssm_a`, `layer.ssm_d` | `{1, n_ssm_head}` | **Mamba2 SSM Core** | **GPU Resident** |
| `layer.ssm_norm` | `{d_inner / n_group, n_group}` | **Mamba2 Norm** | **GPU Resident** |
| `layer.ssm_out` | `{d_inner, n_embd}` | **Mamba2 Output Proj** | **GPU Resident** |
| `layer.ffn_gate_inp` | `{n_embd, n_expert}` | **MoE Gate** | **CPU Offload** (Large: ~100MB+ for 31B model) |
| `layer.ffn_exp_probs_b` | `{n_expert}` | **MoE Bias** | **CPU Offload** |
| `layer.ffn_down_exps` | `{n_ff_exp, moe_n_embd, n_expert}` | **MoE Down Proj** | **CPU Offload** |
| `layer.ffn_up_exps` | `{moe_n_embd, n_ff_exp, n_expert}` | **MoE Up Proj** | **CPU Offload** |
